listing.name: Order from the Boss
listing.summary: A simple mod to solve my problem seeing an ally misses another timing to vent or torpedo enemy. This mod allows you to force allies to do simple things like venting / use shipsystem / toggle shield / fire missile weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you force allies to perform actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missiles.

description:
A simple mod to solve my problem seeing an ally misses another timing to vent or torpedo enemy. This mod allows you to force allies to do simple things like venting / use shipsystem / toggle shield / fire missile weapons.

To use: Hold R and move mouse over an ally as the target, press Q switch target if many modules overlapping.

Download at github link https://github.com/a111164i/Order-from-the-Boss/releases/download/0.98a/Order.from.the.Boss.EN.zip.

aiDescription: Allows players to micromanage allied ships by forcing them to execute specific commands. Users can target an ally and command it to vent, use its ship system, toggle shields, or fire missile weapons.
